content.text:
All three changes are done, checked at 1366x768, 1920x1080 and 375px, and pushed to `New_Features` as commit `36810e7` ("Polish end screen and align widths").

**1. End screen:** The score, message and "Back to modes" button now sit in a card that matches the others. The badge emoji shows large at the top of the card, and a 🪝 shows instead when no badge was earned. That needed a small `showMissedBadge()` function in `app.js` and a wrapper around the left side in `index.html`. The card's content is centered vertically, and on large screens the card matches the right column's height. When the right column is the shorter one, the "Red flags" card grows to fill the gap, so both columns always end at the same line. On phones it all stacks as before.

**2. Mission width:** I removed the mission screen's narrower 1040px limit, so it now uses the same container as the play screen. Both line up exactly with the header logo.

**3. Big screens:** Above 1600px the base font size scales from 16px up to 18px (about 17.6px at 1920). Bodies of text, buttons and inputs now grow with it. Smaller text with fixed pixel sizes, like the topbar counters and the contacts table, stays the same size. Screens 1600px and narrower are unchanged.

**How I checked:** The Chrome extension wasn't connected, so I took screenshots with headless Chrome instead. A temporary test script in my scratch folder jumped straight to each screen with made-up results. Neither the script nor the screenshots are in the repo. The 375px check was done inside a 375px frame, because headless Chrome won't make its window that narrow.
